# TemporalEchoMemory

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The property of a reservoir to retain and integrate past input information over time through its fading memory. Critical for time-series tasks in iNEST, allowing in-network processing of sequential data without external memory.
